description: This file defines the FeatureModified event class, which is part of an event-driven system related to 'things' in the Eclipse Ditto framework. The class models an event emitted after a feature of a thing has been modified, including methods for constructing instances, parsing from JSON, and retrieving feature details.

classes.name: FeatureModified
classes.description: Represents an event emitted after a feature of a thing has been modified. Provides methods for instantiation, JSON serialization/deserialization, and access to feature details.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory methods for creating instances of FeatureModified, with various parameter overloads, including JSON deserialization.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates an instance of FeatureModified from a JSON string or JSON object, parsing relevant fields.

methods.name: getFeature
methods.description: Returns the feature that was modified.

methods.name: getFeatureId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the modified feature.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Returns the JSON representation of the feature as per a specified schema version.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer path to the feature entity.

methods.name: setRevision
methods.description: Creates a new instance with an updated revision.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Creates a new instance with updated Ditto headers.

methods.name: appendPayloadAndBuild
methods.description: Appends the feature payload to a JSON builder for serialization.
